description: Recipe that rebuilds the Kaggle GSDC 2023-2024 submission 56625084 (Private 0.984 m / Public 0.915 m) from the raw test drives. Paths are relative to {gsdc_root} (taroz dataset_2023 root), {gsdc_truth_root} (Kaggle train ground truth) and {work_dir}; {bin} is gnss_fgo_imu_no_base.

submission.coordinate_rule: LatitudeDegrees/LongitudeDegrees are copied verbatim (as text) from the native solution.csv row with the same UnixTimeMillis; no interpolation. Native rows outside the official key list are dropped.

keys.encoding: per tripId, runs of [first UnixTimeMillis, step ms, count]; trips in file order

binary.note: The research runs used four frozen MSVC Release builds (listed per drive under research_source). The recipe runs one build of the current tree; per-drive identity is checked against output_sha256.

height_maps.rule: Per drive: every Kaggle train ground_truth.csv point (lat, lon, alt; files in <course>__<phone>__ground_truth.csv name order) within 30 m horizontally of the drive's stage-0 native trajectory (equirectangular metres, R=6371008.8, lat0=37.4 deg); written as lat_deg,lon_deg,height_m with pandas float_format '%.9f'.
